notes.title: New Objective UI & Bug Fixes Update
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]After the last update where I introduced the new tutorial, I felt that the [b]power objectives[/b] were still a bit underwhelming and needed clearer feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s why this update brings a [b]new UI notification system[/b]: now, when you complete a power objective, the game will show you that progress directly, making your actions feel more impactful and rewarding.[/p][p][/p][p]On top of that, I’ve also fixed two important bugs related to the switches:[/p][list][*][p]After the tutorial, it was impossible to complete the [b]switches objective[/b], this has now been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]switches monitor[/b] was always showing Yellow as Off and Red as On, regardless of the real state. This has also been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for all the feedback and support, every small update helps me make Haunted Mines a better experience![/p][p]– Sergio (XereonDev)[/p]

notes.title: Haunted Mines – Tutorial Overhaul
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

After hearing some of your feedback on [b]Haunted Mines[/b], I’ve made some big changes that I’m really excited to share with you.



[h1]Tutorial Changes[/h1]
One of the most common points of feedback was that the tutorial just wasn’t good enough. With that in mind, I’ve completely reworked the Power Tutorial.

It’s now a dedicated level that guides you step by step through the Power Objective, showing how it works, and how to complete it successfully.



[h1]Hold Timers[/h1]
In Haunted Mines there are certain objects that are Holdable, meaning you need to interact with them for a few seconds to activate them.

Originally, these were designed to create tension: forcing you to stay vulnerable for a short time, and making you carefully choose when to interact (ideally when the Monster wasn’t nearby).

However, many players felt the timers were just too long, which made things feel a bit boring.

So, I’ve adjusted them:

Easier difficulties → much faster hold times.

Harder difficulties → hold times are closer to the original design.

This should strike a better balance between tension and fun.



[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the main door of the first room would open and close at the start of every game.
[*] Fixed a bug where the map could generate multiple times, causing crashes.
[/list]

notes.title: Haunted Mines Is Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I’m thrilled to announce that [b][i]Haunted Mines[/i][/b] has officially launched on Steam! 🎉
To celebrate, the game is available with a [b]20% discount during the first week[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Since this is an [b]Early Access release[/b], you may encounter some bugs or issues, but I’ll be working hard to fix them as quickly as possible. Your feedback will be essential in shaping the game’s future.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for all the support! I can’t wait to see you exploring the mines![/p][p][/p][p]– Sergio (XereonDev)[/p]

notes.title: Haunted Mines - Development Milestone
notes.content: [p][/p][h2][b]Haunted Mines - Development Milestone[/b][/h2][p]I'm thrilled to finally say it, after over [b]2 years of solo development[/b], [i]Haunted Mines[/i] is [b]getting closer than ever to release[/b].[/p][p]What began as a simple idea has evolved into a deep, atmospheric horror experience powered by custom AI systems, online multiplayer, and dynamic match progression. And now, I'm ready to share more with you.[/p][h2][b]2 Years of Building[/b][/h2][p]This project started as a solo endeavor, born from a love for psychological horror and asymmetrical tension. Since then, the game has grown into something far bigger and more polished than I ever expected.[/p][p]Over the past two years, I've worked on:[/p][list][*][p]🔄 [b]Procedural map generation[/b] (so no run feels the same)[/p][/*][*][p]🧠 [b]Dual-Brain AI[/b] for the monster, designed to simulate both instinct and knowledge-based behavior[/p][/*][*][p]👥 [b]Online multiplayer[/b], using [b]Mirror[/b] and [b]Steamworks[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔊 [b]3D voice chat integration[/b] via [b]Vivox[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]Custom interaction systems[/b], task management, and match progression logic[/p][/*][*][p]🧰 Inventory, upgrades, economy systems, and match rewards[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s been a journey full of learning curves, especially integrating third-party tools like [b]Mirror[/b], [b]FizzySteamworks[/b], and [b]Vivox[/b], which all come with their own challenges. But the result is a unique multiplayer horror experience that I’m proud of.[/p][h2][b]Where We Are Now[/b][/h2][p]The game is now [b]feature-complete for an early access version[/b], meaning:[/p][list][*][p]All core gameplay systems are implemented[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer is kinda functional... You can play it, maybe not enjoy it, but at least try it out [url="https://emojipedia.org/es/cara-sonriendo-con-sudor-fr%C3%ADo"]😅[/url][/p][/*][*][p]The game loop is working from start to finish[/p][/*][*][p]It’s [b]stable and playable[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]What remains is [b]polish, optimization, bug hunting, and tuning, [/b]especially now that early testers are providing valuable feedback.[/p][h2][b]What Comes Next?[/b][/h2][p]Right now, I’m working on:[/p][list][*][p]✨ Visual polish: FX, lighting, UI feedback, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]🐞 Bug fixing and QoL improvements[/p][/*][*][p]📢 Marketing and wishlist growth (Steam & Itch)[/p][/*][*][p]📹 Reaching out to content creators and testers[/p][/*][*][p]🧱 Possibly adding more monster behavior depth, depending on feedback[/p][/*][/list][p]I’ve also started preparing pages on both [b]Steam and Itch.io[/b]. Your [b]wishlist, comment, or share really helps, [/b]it’s the best way to support a solo dev like me.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487740/Haunted_Mines/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Thank You![/b][/h2][p]To everyone who’s followed the project, tested early builds, or just shown interest, thank you.[/p][p][i]Haunted Mines[/i] has been a passion project from the start, and I’m incredibly excited (and slightly nervous) to show it to the world. This devlog is just one step toward launch, and I can’t wait to bring you more updates soon.[/p][p]If you'd like to follow the development more closely, stay tuned here if you want to participate in future testing.[/p]
